$comment: Type-checking for the operational scripts (#419). They are not BUILT — `tsc` still compiles src/ into dist/ from tsconfig.json alone, so neither the build's output nor its speed changes. What this adds is a guard: a script that stops compiling fails `npm run check:types` instead of failing mid-operation on real data. `rootDir` is widened to the repo root because several scripts import core straight from source rather than through the built package; with `noEmit` it shapes nothing, it only has to be wide enough not to reject those files.
